limitations: Three wallets per group, six per side after pooling.
The automated confirmation takes about 266 ms, less than one prepare exchange, so 42-90 ms of the prepare still follows the confirmation. A person takes longer, and the wait then disappears.

The SDK payloads of the two sides come from different trees: the late-prepare payload is the frozen early-preflight payload of the earlier runs, the early-prepare payload is public 2b0e427d plus the change. Registration uses the same code path in both.
A second launcher started the same driver three seconds after the first; it stopped at its own active-run check before any staging call and left a traceback at the top of the log.
